procedure: Record exact Raspberry Pi Zero board revision, removable microSD image, camera module, ST7789 display HAT, and GPIO button wiring.
Run nseal-vault hardware-probe --out hardware-probe.json and attach the non-destructive setup report.
Prepare a companion-generated nseal1 signing request QR that includes request id and approval_digest review binding evidence.
Scan the nseal1 static request QR with the Pi camera and record scan distance, brightness, and angle notes.
Scan the nseal1 animated request QR with the Pi camera when the request exceeds the static QR limit.
Render Event, Content, Tags, and Decision trusted review pages on the local display before any approval.
Navigate the review with GPIO button actions: next, scroll, approve, and reject; record that reject is distinct from approve.
Approve only from the final Decision page after review traversal and emit the signed-event QR response on the device display.
Verify the signed-event QR response with companion verify-response against the original request id and event template.
Repeat one rejection path and confirm no signed-event QR response is emitted.
Confirm the flow uses no USB data transport, no persistent signing secret, no TROPIC01, and RAM-only session custody.
expected_result: The Raspberry/Pi full QR flow scans nseal1 static and animated request QR frames with the Pi camera, renders complete trusted review on the SeedSigner-compatible display, navigates with physical GPIO next/scroll/approve/reject buttons, binds approval to request id and approval_digest, emits a signed-event QR response only after approval, verifies the response with companion verify-response, emits no response on reject, uses no USB data transport, and keeps RAM-only custody with no persistent secret and no TROPIC01.
